events.title: Demo update: match speed setting, smoother matches, fairer goals
events.summary: Thanks for the playtests this week. What changed:- Match speed setting (1x / 2x / 4x) in Settings. Hold SPACE or right mouse during scoring for an instant 4x. - The goal threshold on the rope now updates the moment a hand ends, on both sides. events.title: Small update, big download – sorry about that
events.summary: Small update, big download – sorry about that This patch only fixes one thing: the computer app names now show in English when the game language is English.The download is large because I changed how the build is packaged.Until now the whole game was one compressed file, so even a tiny fix meant re-downloading most of it.From this version on, only the files that actually change will be downloaded.So this one is big, the next ones will be small. Your saves are not affected.

events.title: The free demo is live!
events.summary: Cartagol: Football Card Career now has a playable demo on Steam. Play your entire debut season: every match is a card battle, and every week your coach decides whether you deserve the shirt. Craft your own cards, chase transfers, and see how far one season takes you. Your demo progress carries over to the full game. Top your first season on the in-game leaderboard, and tell us what you think on Discord: https://discord.gg/FmGDezEKwd
